trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User requests course withdrawal and refund.
steps.text: हेलो, मुझे अपना admission cancel करना है और refund चाहिए।
steps.clean_text: हेलो, मुझे अपना admission cancel करना है और refund चाहिए।
steps.model_visible_text: हेलो, मुझे अपना admission pencil करना है और refund चाहिए।

steps.expected_behavior: Identify that the application ID is missing and ask the user for it before proceeding.
steps.text: I can help you with that. Cancellation process शुरू करने के लिए, क्या आप मुझे अपना application ID बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The user requested a withdrawal but did not provide an identifier; the agent must obtain the application ID to look up the account.

steps.text: हाँ, मेरा application ID APP-2003 है।
Thank you. Account verify करने के लिए, please अपना registered name और date of birth confirm कीजिये।
मेरा नाम विवेक है और date of birth 14th August 1999 है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and ask user to wait.
steps.text: Verification complete हो गया है, विवेक। मैं अभी आपकी fee और refund details check करती हूँ। एक मिनट लाइन पर रहिये।

steps.purpose: State fee paid and weeks since start.
steps.text: Thank you for waiting. आपका fee account show कर रहा है कि आपने 195000 pay किया है और due 0 है। लेकिन system के according course start हुए 11 weeks हो चुके हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must state the facts found in the lookup_fee_account result before explaining the refund.

steps.text: हाँ, तो मेरा कितना refund बनेगा?

steps.purpose: Explain refund slab, percentage, and processing window.
steps.text: क्यूंकि 11 weeks हो चुके हैं, आपका withdrawal 'After 10 weeks' slab में आता है। इस slab का refund percent 0 है, इसलिए refundable amount 0 होगा और processing days भी 0 हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for the refund amount; the agent must explain the refund slab, percentage, and processing window as required by the terminal success conditions.

steps.text: Zero? यह कैसे possible है? मैंने पूरे 1.95 lakhs pay किये हैं। आप zero कैसे बोल सकते हैं? मुझे proper reason बताइये।

steps.purpose: Reiterate refund policy based on slab.
steps.text: मैं आपकी परेशानी समझती हूँ। लेकिन refund percentage strictly withdrawal date के slab पर depend करता है। आपका account 'After 10 weeks' slab में है, जिसका refund 0% है।
steps.planner_rationale: The sceptical user disputes the zero refund; the agent must reiterate that the refund is strictly based on the slab returned by the tool.

steps.text: अच्छा, लेकिन मेरी 25% scholarship थी। उसका क्या? क्या उस वजह से मुझे कुछ वापस नहीं मिलेगा?
आपकी 25% scholarship आपकी total fee पर apply हुई थी। लेकिन refund का calculation सिर्फ weeks since start पर based होता है, जो कि 11 weeks है। इसलिए refund 0 ही रहेगा।
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked about their scholarship; the agent must explain that the scholarship applies to the fee but the refund is based on weeks since start.

steps.text: तो आप लोग एक रुपया भी वापस नहीं करेंगे? क्या कोई और तरीका नहीं है, कोई waiver या discount?
मैं माफ़ी चाहती हूँ, लेकिन मैं कोई waiver या discount offer नहीं कर सकती जो system में नहीं है। Refundable amount 0 ही है।
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for a waiver; the agent must strictly refuse as per the business rules.

steps.purpose: User asks for exact calculation of 10 weeks.
steps.text: यह तो बिलकुल ठीक नहीं है। आप मुझे exact calculation बताइये कि 10 weeks कब ख़त्म हुए।

steps.purpose: Refuse to provide exact dates not in tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: Base the response strictly on the tool output, refusing to calculate or provide exact dates not present in the result.
steps.text: मेरे पास exact dates नहीं हैं, system सिर्फ यह show कर रहा है कि 11 weeks हो चुके हैं और आपका slab 'After 10 weeks' है। इसलिए refund 0% है।
steps.planner_rationale: The user asks for the exact date the 10 weeks ended, but the tool only provides weeks_since_start; the agent must not invent or calculate the date.

steps.text: ठीक है, अगर system में यही है तो मैं क्या ही बोलूं। मैं management से बात करूँगा बाद में।
I understand your frustration, विवेक। क्या मैं आपकी किसी और डिटेल के साथ मदद कर सकती हूँ आज?
नहीं, बस यही था। मैं खुद देख लूँगा अब।

ir.terminal_condition: Withdrawal refund explained with the slab, percentage and processing window.
